# Needs-context input packets — 2026-10-22

These 49 JSONL packets contain the exact **497** frozen-catalogue entries whose description-completion status was `needs_context`.

- The historical snapshot has 498 `needs_context` rows. One has no catalogue entry number and is deliberately excluded from this assignment.
- Packets are deterministic and sorted by `entry_number`. Packet 01 has 25 records; packets 02–48 have 10; packet 49 has 2.
- `existing_copy_for_context_only` and `research_hints` are leads, not proof. They can include out-of-date, incomplete, or overstated claims. Workers must keep only statements supportable by credible sources and record uncertainty rather than filling gaps.
- The authoritative assignment list remains `../needs-context-assignment-2026-10-22.json`; these packets provide the compact row-level context that GitHub web tools can retrieve.

Each research run must preserve the frozen export and canonical data. It should write append-only proposed editorial results to a new dated output directory.
